scenarios.prompt: A combat event requests a temporary music duck while a scene retry restarts music. Route named cues/buses and settle to one loop after repeated callbacks.

criteria.ownership: Audio buses own routing/mix/duck/loop reconciliation; audio-feel/gameplay own event meaning.
criteria.state: Bus/snapshot/loop identities and transition policies are project data and idempotent.
criteria.evidence: Mix state can be reconstructed from event and route logs without changing gameplay clocks.
